pages.title: The Last Line of Defense
body: After spending over 14 years in the world of software testing — asking questions, breaking things on purpose, and fighting for better quality — I poured my journey, lessons, and wild bug stories into this book.
This on-site edition lives here so you can read it without leaving this site. The original SimpleBooklet copy is no longer published.

pages.title: For testers — and anyone in tech
body: This book isn’t just for testers. It’s for anyone who’s ever worked in tech, been curious about what QA really does, or just wants a behind-the-scenes look at the chaos and care that goes into making software work.
I’ve shared real-life stories (the funny and the frustrating), lessons I wish I knew earlier, and a whole lot of heart.

pages.title: Celebrate the testers
body: If it makes you laugh, nod, or think differently about QA, I would love it if you gave it a read.
Thanks for being part of this journey with me. Let’s celebrate the testers — the last line of defense.

pages.title: Pournima Tele
body: Hands-on Senior Software Engineer with 14+ years in Quality Engineering, Test Automation and AI-driven development.

After leading QA teams, I returned to hands-on engineering — currently Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer in Aircall’s Messaging team, and Engineering Team Lead for QA Automation, working with AI-driven development.
Based in Milton Keynes, UK. Open to collaboration, new opportunities and exciting projects.
